output.headline: Takes a Support position on five state bills, from school walk zones to a school facilities bond
output.summary: The board is adopting the district's position on five proposed state bills as of June 12, 2024, and the recommended position on every one is Support. They cover school walk zones (AB 2583), a guaranteed income program for homeless high school seniors (SB 333), a state apology for chattel slavery (AB 3089), grants for student teachers (AB 238) and a statewide school facilities bond (AB 247). This item itself costs the district nothing.
